description: Details of an existing booking: status, route, pickup time, price, payment, driver information once assigned, and the manage-booking URL. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch. The booking reference is either the APL-xxxxxx format from the confirmation email or the numeric reservation ID; both work.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — either "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869", as on the confirmation email) or the numeric LT reservation ID (e.g. "966244"). Both formats accepted.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: lookup_booking
title: Look Up Booking
